title: Statistical Inference with Ill-Conditioned Random Weight Neural Network Sieves
abstract: arXiv:2611.26410v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random weight neural networks (RWNNs) are shallow networks whose hidden-layer parameters are randomly generated and then kept fixed, while only the output coefficients are estimated. Conditional on the sampled parameters, RWNN regression is a linear sieve problem with random approximation space. We show that such random sieves cannot remain uniformly well-conditioned as their dimension grows. For parametrized feature families satisfying polynomial covering and Lipschitz conditions, the eigenvalues of the population covariance matrix are proven to have polynomial upper bounds determined by the covering geometry of the parameter space, leading to a vanishing smallest eigenvalue. We develop approximation, estimation, and inference theory that explicitly treats the ill-conditioning. Under a $\beta$-H\"older source condition, we obtain both faster-than-Monte-Carlo $L^2$ approximation rates and new $L^\infty$ approximation bounds based on st

translated_title: 基于病态随机权重神经网络筛的统计推断
translated_abstract: 随机权重神经网络（RWNN）是一类浅层网络，其隐藏层参数为随机生成并保持固定，仅对输出系数进行估计。在给定采样参数的条件下，RWNN回归可视为一个具有随机逼近空间的线性筛问题。我们证明，随着维数的增长，这类随机筛无法始终保持一致的良好条件性。对于满足多项式覆盖条件与Lipschitz条件的参数化特征族，我们证明了总体协方差矩阵的特征值具有由参数空间覆盖几何结构决定的多项式上界，从而导致最小特征值趋于消失。我们发展了显式处理这种病态性的逼近、估计与推断理论。在β-Hölder源条件下，我们同时获得了快于蒙特卡洛速率的L²逼近速率，以及基于……（原文摘要在此处截断）的新L^∞逼近界。
tldr: 本文证明了随机权重神经网络筛在维数增大时必然出现病态性（最小特征值消失），并在显式处理该病态性的基础上建立了相应的逼近速率、估计与统计推断理论。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that random weight neural network sieves inevitably become ill-conditioned as their dimension grows, with a vanishing smallest eigenvalue, and develops approximation, estimation, and inference theory that explicitly accounts for this ill-conditioning.
